# IMADI Tech

> IMADI Tech is an AI automation company in Karachi, Pakistan, founded by Maria Aziz in May 2026. It builds WhatsApp chatbots and lead follow-up automation, custom ERP and business management systems, and SaaS products for small and mid-sized businesses. It has delivered projects in Pakistan, the UK and Kenya and also takes on clients in the UAE.

Contact: maria@imadi.tech · Website: https://www.imadi.tech

## Services
- [WhatsApp & Instagram lead automation](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/): an AI assistant that replies to every enquiry instantly, shares designs and price ranges, sends PDF quotations, follows up automatically and tracks every lead in a dashboard. Best fit: furniture, kitchen, interior, building supply and logistics businesses.
- [FAQ](https://www.imadi.tech/faq/): pricing model, setup, languages, WhatsApp number questions.

- [WhatsApp chatbot and AI automation developer in Pakistan](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-chatbot-developer-pakistan/): Maria Aziz's developer profile, tech stack (Python, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Graph API) and shipped systems.

## By industry
- [A WhatsApp assistant for furniture and interior businesses](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/furniture/): WhatsApp automation for furniture showrooms and interior firms in Karachi: instant replies with designs and prices, size questions, PDF quotes and automatic follow-ups.
- [A WhatsApp assistant for kitchen and wardrobe companies](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/kitchens-wardrobes/): WhatsApp automation for kitchen, cabinet and wardrobe makers: collect measurements and photos, book site visits, send quotations and follow up automatically.
- [WhatsApp bots for logistics and delivery companies](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/logistics/): WhatsApp bots for logistics companies: rate questions, order inquiries, damage claims with photos and documents, and a dashboard to approve or reject them.
- [WhatsApp automation for businesses in Dubai and the UAE](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/dubai-uae/): WhatsApp chatbots and lead follow-up automation for UAE businesses: instant replies to ad inquiries, quotations, follow-ups and a lead dashboard, built remotely by IMADI Tech.
